---
name: Zombie process prevention rule
description: Before every new eval submission, must kill old processes on target GPU + verify GPU empty with nvidia-smi, then submit. submit_training_job does NOT kill old processes.
type: feedback
---

Before submitting ANY new eval on a GPU, MUST: (1) kill ALL old eval processes on that GPU, (2) verify GPU empty with nvidia-smi, (3) only then submit.

**Why:** submit_training_job creates new tmux sessions but does NOT kill old processes. kill_job may only kill the tmux wrapper, not the child python process. Repeated kill+resubmit cycles accumulated zombie python processes competing for the same GPU (up to 5 processes on one GPU), all running slowly. Discovered 2026-05-23 by Reviewer SSH inspection.

**How to apply:** Every time you submit a new eval or training job on a GPU, first spawn a worker to: `ps aux | grep eval_math500` to find old PIDs, `kill -9` them, `nvidia-smi` to verify 0% utilization on target GPU, then submit. Never assume GPU is clean just because registry says the old experiment is DONE.
